name: Screenshot
description: Capture the screen and keep a local screenshot history in DBX. Saving can copy the image to the clipboard (overwrites current clipboard contents; toggle in settings). On Linux, region capture needs gnome-screenshot, spectacle, or scrot on PATH.
releaseNotes: 0.1.2: multi-display picker; crop aspect ratios (free/16:9/4:3/1:1/custom) with in-bounds handles; fix crop undo losing the image; clearer Linux region-tool missing error; listing notes for Linux region CLI deps.

zh-CN.name: 截图
zh-CN.description: 截取屏幕并在 DBX 中保存本机截图历史。保存后可复制到剪贴板（会覆盖当前剪贴板内容，可在设置中关闭）。Linux 区域截图需系统已安装 gnome-screenshot、spectacle 或 scrot。
